html:
Hanoi to Pu Luong Private Car brings you a high class travel experience with well equipped vehicles, private trips, on demand schedules, and door to door transport. The private transfer by Vietlook Travel promises to take you from Hanoi to Pu Luong Nature Reserve without common travel hassles.

Distance From Hanoi/Hanoi Airport To Pu Luong

The Hanoi to Pu Luong distance is expected to be about 150 kilometers. The route will take approximately 4.5 hours for a direct transfer by private car from Ha Noi to Pu Luong. Check the following map from Hanoi to Pu Luong Nature Reserve for more details:

You can choose a shared bus or taxi for this route, but you may suffer from delays, crowds, unsuitable schedules, extra transfers, or high charges. By booking our private transfer service, your convenience and requests are prioritized.

How To Reserve A Private Car Hanoi To Pu Luong?

Vietlook Travel prioritizes both service quality and overall customer experience. To make our professional transportation service easily accessible, we provide several convenient booking options across various platforms, including:

  • Hotline: (+84) 98.339.3588
  • Website: https://vietlooktravel.com
  • Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/vietlooktour

Hanoi To Pu Luong By Private Car

As a private transportation service, we allow passengers to opt for their convenient itinerary, departure place, arrival location, and suitable car type. Following your wants, we will arrange a private high quality car and driver for you.

The car will show up on time right at your requested place in Hanoi (hotels, the Old Quarter, airport, or so). After you get picked up, the driver will start the trip to Pu Luong Nature Reserve.

On the route to Pu Luong, you can enjoy refreshing landscapes across peaceful Hoa Binh Province. Most interestingly, the car will pass by Thung Khe Pass, a breathtaking road meandering a great mountain in Mai Chau.

We will offer you a stop at Thung Khe Market near the mountaintop, which commodates stalls run by the locals. You can drop by a rustic native stall to sip some warm tea, eat local dishes, and enjoy the views. Mai Chau Valley, layers of mountain peaks, and big clouds will inspire you to take lots of pictures.

Apart from the Thung Khe Pass, you can ask our driver to make short stops for breaks, toilets, or cigarettes.

Eventually, the car will get to your chosen place in Pu Luong Nature Reserve. You will get off, get the luggage carrying support from our driver, and say goodbye to him. After all, your private car transfer from Hanoi to Pu Luong comes to an end.

Travel Tips

  • You should make a beforehand booking, especially when traveling to Pu Luong during peak tourism seasons (summer and holidays).
  • The best time to visit Pu Luong is from May to October. You will enjoy its green fields in summer and its golden harvest in autumn.
  • Attractions in Pu Luong Nature Reserve are Bat Cave (Hang Doi), Pho Doan Market, and local villages, such as Son Ba Muoi, Ban Kho Muong, Ban Hieu, and Ban Don. Amazing untouched nature and interesting local life will give you a real treat.
  • If you love to taste some local food, we recommend Co Lung duck, com lam (bamboo tube rice), hill chicken, stream fish, and bitter bamboo shoots.
